publication: Frank Pfenning, Logic Programming, Lecture6: Unification (2006-09-14)

reviews.checked_passages: §§6.2–6.7, L6.2–L6.9: substitution composition, definition of MGU, soundness and most-generality proof, termination discussion.
reviews.consumers: Term unification: substitutions and most general solutions.
reviews.outcome: No serious defect in the adopted factorization argument. The source uses finite valid substitutions and constrained composition. The corpus instead uses its existing total simultaneous substitutions, proves composition directly, and establishes arbitrary-target-alphabet factorization and a separate lexicographic termination measure. Complexity/Prolog implementation claims are outside the adopted scope.
